70800.commentary: (MNa) hatappahate niviṭṭho'ti hate ca parassa pahāradāne, pahate ca paramāraṇe niviṭṭho.

examples.text: kathañ'ca, gahapatayo, tividhaṃ kāyena adhammacariyāvisamacariyā hoti? idha, gahapatayo, ekacco pāṇ'ātipātī hoti, luddo lohitapāṇi hatappahate niviṭṭho aday'āpanno pāṇabhūtesu.

ayaṃ pan'ettha saṅkhepo, bhagavato kira bhikkhusaṅghassa ca pañcannaṃ mahānadīnaṃ mah'oghasadise lābhasakkāre uppanne hatalābhasakkārā aññatitthiyā sūriy'uggamanakāle khajjopanakā viya nippabhā hutvā ekato sannipatitvā mantayiṃsu.

70803.meaning1: destroyed one's chance; lost the opportunity

examples.text: assaddho akataññū ca, sandhicchedo ca yo naro, hat'āvakāso vant'āso, sa ve uttamaporiso.

70804.meaning2: who has cut off every occasion of good and evil

examples.text: assaddho akataññū ca, sandhicchedo ca yo naro, hat'āvakāso vant'āso, sa ve uttamaporiso.
ye te hat'āvasesakā bhavissanti, te pacchā rañño janapadaṃ viheṭhessanti.

70806.meaning1: who has killed the cause; who has destroyed the precondition for

examples.text: dussīlassa, bhikkhave, sīlavipannassa hat'ūpaniso hoti sammāsamādhi, sammāsamādhimhi asati sammāsamādhivipannassa hat'ūpanisaṃ hoti yathābhūtañāṇadassanaṃ, yathābhūtañāṇadassane asati yathābhūta-ñāṇadassana-vipannassa hat'ūpaniso hoti nibbidāvirāgo, nibbidāvirāge asati nibbidāvirāgavipannassa hat'ūpanisaṃ hoti vimuttiñāṇadassanaṃ.
hatthesu, bhikkhave, sati ādānanikkhepanaṃ paññāyati. pādesu sati abhikkamapaṭikkamo paññāyati. pabbesu sati samiñjanapasāraṇaṃ paññāyati. kucchismiṃ sati jighacchāpipāsā paññāyati.
taṃ kiṃ maññasi, sunakkhatta, api nu so puriso amussa āsīvisassa ghoravisassa hatthaṃ vā aṅguṭṭhaṃ vā dajjā yaṃ jaññā, imin'āhaṃ daṭṭho maraṇaṃ vā nigacchāmi maraṇamattaṃ vā dukkhan'ti?

seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, yavakalāpī cātumahāpathe nikkhittā assa. atha cha purisā āgaccheyyuṃ byābhaṅgihatthā. te yavakalāpiṃ chahi byābhaṅgīhi haneyyuṃ. evañ'hi sā, bhikkhave, yavakalāpī suhatā assa chahi byābhaṅgīhi haññamānā.
muṇḍo virūpo abhisāpam'āgato, kapālahattho'va kulesu bhikkhasu, yuñjassu satthuvacane mah'esino, itissu maṃ citta pure niyuñjasi.
pañca uppalahatthāni, āveḷatthaṃ ahaṃsu me, tena buddhaṃ apūjesiṃ, pasanno sehi pāṇibhi.

70810.meaning1: measure of length; cubit; measure from elbow to extended middle finger-tip

examples.text: tatra, bhikkhave, ye te makkaṭā abālajātikā alolajātikā, te taṃ lepaṃ disvā ārakā parivajjanti. yo pana so hoti makkaṭo bālajātiko lolajātiko, so taṃ lepaṃ upasaṅkamitvā hatthena gaṇhāti.

70814.meaning1: name of a layman in Āḷavī; great disciple of the Buddha; foremost layman in supporting a group with the four bases for sustaining relationships
70814.commentary: (ANa) hatthako āḷavako'ti hatthato hatthaṃ gatattā evaṃladdhanāmo āḷavako rājaputto.

examples.text: atha kho hatthako āḷavako jaṅghāvihāraṃ anucaṅkamamāno anuvicaramāno addasa bhagavantaṃ gomagge siṃsapāvane paṇṇasanthare nisinnaṃ.
etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, mama sāvakānaṃ upāsakānaṃ catūhi saṅgahavatthūhi parisaṃ saṅgaṇhantānaṃ yadidaṃ hatthako āḷavako.

70822.meaning1: fidgeting with the hands; fiddling with the hands
70822.commentary: (MNa) hatthakukkuccan'ti pattamukhavaṭṭiyaṃ udakabinduṭhapanaṃ makkhikabījaniyā paṇṇacchedanaphālan'ādi hatthena asaṃyatakaraṇaṃ.

examples.text: so antaraghare nisinno samāno na hatthakukkuccaṃ āpajjati, na pādakukkuccaṃ āpajjati, na adduvena adduvaṃ āropetvā nisīdati, na ca gopphakena gopphakaṃ āropetvā nisīdati, na ca pāṇinā hanukaṃ upadahitvā nisīdati.

70823.meaning1: in one's possession; under one's control; secured

examples.text: yo c'eva, pāpima, brahmā, yā ca brahmaparisā, ye ca brahmapārisajjā, sabb'eva tava hatthagatā sabb'eva tava vasaṃgatā.
yato kayitañ'ca hoti vikkayitañ'ca attano bhaṇḍaṃ parahatthagataṃ parabhaṇḍaṃ attano hatthagataṃ, nissaggiyaṃ hoti.

70826.commentary: (KVa) hatthaggahaṇan'ti ettha ca yassa kassaci apārājikakkhettabhūtassa aṅgassa gahaṇaṃ hatthaggahaṇaṃ

70827.meaning1: holding hands; taking hold of the hand

examples.text: yo pana bhikkhu otiṇṇo vipariṇatena cittena mātugāmena saddhiṃ kāyasaṃsaggaṃ samāpajjeyya hatthaggāhaṃ vā veṇiggāhaṃ vā aññatarassa vā aññatarassa vā aṅgassa parāmasanaṃ, saṅgh'ādiseso.

70828.meaning1: whose hand is cut off; who has an amputated hand

examples.text: dujjīvitaṃ nāma hatthacchinnassa pādacchinnassa hatthapādacchinnassa kaṇṇacchinnassa nāsacchinnassa kaṇṇanāsacchinnassa, iminā ca pāpakena iminā ca dujjīvitena mataṃ te jīvitā seyyo'ti.

70830.meaning1: amputating a hand; having a hand cut off

examples.text: hatthacchedanam'pi dukkhaṃ, pādacchedanam'pi dukkhaṃ, hatthapādacchedanam'pi dukkhaṃ, kaṇṇacchedanam'pi dukkhaṃ, nāsacchedanam'pi dukkhaṃ, kaṇṇanāsacchedanam'pi dukkhaṃ… evarūpāni, mahārāja, bahuvidhāni anekavidhāni dukkhāni saṃsāragato anubhavati.

puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, bhikkhu seyyathā'pi passeyya sarīraṃ sivathikāya chaḍḍitaṃ aṭṭhikāni apagatasambandhāni disā vidisā vikkhittāni, aññena hatth'aṭṭhikaṃ aññena pād'aṭṭhikaṃ aññena gopphak'aṭṭhikaṃ aññena jaṅgh'aṭṭhikaṃ aññena ūru'ṭṭhikaṃ aññena kaṭi'ṭṭhikaṃ aññena phāsuk'aṭṭhikaṃ aññena piṭṭhi'ṭṭhikaṃ aññena khandh'aṭṭhikaṃ aññena gīv'aṭṭhikaṃ aññena hanuk'aṭṭhikaṃ aññena dant'aṭṭhikaṃ aññena sīsakaṭāhaṃ.

70834.meaning1: palm of the hand and sole of the foot

examples.text: yo pana bhikkhu aññātikāya bhikkhuniyā hatthato cīvaraṃ paṭiggaṇheyya aññatra pārivattakā, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
yo pana bhikkhu aññātikāya bhikkhuniyā antaragharaṃ paviṭṭhāya hatthato khādanīyaṃ vā bhojanīyaṃ vā sahatthā paṭiggahetvā khādeyya vā bhuñjeyya vā, paṭidesetabbaṃ tena bhikkhunā

70837.meaning1: death at the hand; end in the hand (of)

examples.text: te'pi corassa aṅgulimālassa hatth'atthaṃ gacchantī'ti.

70838.commentary: (MNa) idha bhavaṃ raṭṭhapālo hatth'atthare nisīdatū'ti hatth'attharo tanuko bahalapupph'ādiguṇaṃ katvā atthato abhilakkhito hoti, tādise anāpucchitvā nisīdituṃ na yuttan'ti maññamāno evam'āha.

examples.text: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sāraṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekam'antaṃ aṭṭhāsi. ekam'antaṃ ṭhito kho rājā korabyo āyasmantaṃ raṭṭhapālaṃ etadavoca, idha bhavaṃ raṭṭhapāla hatth'atthare nisīdatū'ti.

70839.commentary: (MNt) hatth'attharaṇā hatthirūpavicittā. ass'attharaka-sīh'attharak'ādayo'pi assasīharūp'ādivicittā eva attharakā, citt'attharakaṃ nānārūpehi c'eva nānāvidhamālākamm'ādīhi ca vicittaṃ attharakaṃ.

70840.meaning1: elephant blanket; elephant rug; (comm) spread decorated with elephants

examples.text: seyyath'idaṃ, āsandiṃ pallaṅkaṃ gonakaṃ cittakaṃ paṭikaṃ paṭalikaṃ tūlikaṃ vikatikaṃ uddalomiṃ ek'antalomiṃ kaṭṭissaṃ koseyyaṃ kuttakaṃ hatthattharaṇaṃ ass'attharaṇaṃ rath'attharaṇaṃ ajinappaveṇiṃ kadalimiga-pavara-paccattharaṇaṃ sauttaracchadaṃ ubhato-lohitak'ūpadhānaṃ

70841.meaningLit: rule about shaking (food off) the hand

70842.grammar: ind, adv, comp, acc sg of hatthaniddhunaka

examples.text: na hatthaniddhunakaṃ bhuñjissāmī'ti sikkhā karaṇīyā.
na hatthaniddhunakaṃ bhuñjitabbaṃ. yo anādariyaṃ paṭicca hatthaniddhunakaṃ bhuñjati, āpatti dukkaṭassa.

70844.grammar: ind, adv, comp, acc sg of hatthanillehaka
70844.commentary: (VINa) hatthanillehakan'ti hatthaṃ nillehitvā nillehitvā. bhuñjantena hi aṅgulimattam'pi nillehituṃ na vaṭṭati. ghanayāgu-phāṇita-pāyās'ādike pana aṅgulīhi gahetvā aṅguliyo mukhe pavesetvā bhuñjituṃ vaṭṭati.

examples.text: na hatthanillehakaṃ bhuñjissāmī'ti sikkhā karaṇīyā.
na hatthanillehakaṃ bhuñjitabbaṃ. yo anādariyaṃ paṭicca hatthanillehakaṃ bhuñjati, āpatti dukkaṭassa.

70845.commentary: (MNa) hatthapajjotikan'ti hatthe telapilotikāya veṭhetvā dīpaṃ viya jālenti.

examples.text: tam'enaṃ rājāno gahetvā vividhā kammakāraṇā kārenti… bilaṅgathālikam'pi karonti, saṅkhamuṇḍikam'pi karonti, rāhumukham'pi karonti, jotimālikam'pi karonti, hatthapajjotikam'pi karonti, erakavattikam'pi karonti

70846.meaning1: sitting posture with the arms clasped around the knees

examples.text: na pallatthikāya antaraghare nisīditabbaṃ. yo anādariyaṃ paṭicca hatthapallatthikāya vā dussapallatthikāya vā antaraghare nisīdati, āpatti dukkaṭassa.
na pallatthikāya nisinnassa agilānassa dhammo desetabbo. yo anādariyaṃ paṭicca hatthapallatthikāya vā dussapallatthikāya vā nisinnassa agilānassa dhammaṃ deseti, āpatti dukkaṭassa.

70848.meaning1: hand and foot; hands and feet

examples.text: dujjīvitaṃ nāma hatthacchinnassa pādacchinnassa hatthapādacchinnassa kaṇṇacchinnassa nāsacchinnassa kaṇṇanāsacchinnassa, iminā ca pāpakena iminā ca dujjīvitena mataṃ te jīvitā seyyo'ti.

sabbapaṭhamaṃ tāva kiñci'd'eva karuṇāyitabbarūpaṃ… hatthapādehi paggharantakimigaṇaṃ aṭṭassaraṃ karontaṃ disvā, kicchaṃ vat'āyaṃ satto āpanno, app'eva nāma imamhā dukkhā mucceyyā'ti karuṇā pavattetabbā.

70849.meaning1: whose hands and feet are cut off; with amputated hands and feet

examples.text: dujjīvitaṃ nāma hatthacchinnassa pādacchinnassa hatthapādacchinnassa kaṇṇacchinnassa nāsacchinnassa kaṇṇanāsacchinnassa, iminā ca pāpakena iminā ca dujjīvitena mataṃ te jīvitā seyyo'ti.

70850.meaning2: for hands, feet, back, ears, etc.

70851.meaning2: detail of hands, feet, mouth, etc.

70852.meaning2: hands, feet, mouth, etc. the limbs of the body

examples.text: satta c'ussade idh'ādhigacchati, hatthapādamudutañ'ca vindati, āhu byañjananimittakovidā, khajjabhojjarasalābhitāya naṃ.

70854.compound: dvanda (hatthā ca pādā ca ādayo ca)

examples.text: tassa hi pittajararogo bhavissati. ten'assa uṇh'odakaṃ pivituṃ vā hatthapād'ādi-dhovan'atthāya vā gattaparisiñcan'atthāya vā upanetuṃ na vaṭṭati, rogo balavataro hoti. sīt'odakaṃ vaṭṭati, rogaṃ vūpasameti.

70855.commentary: (VINa) hatthapāsā vā na vijahitabban'ti atha vā taṃ gharaṃ samantato hatthapāsā na vijahitabbaṃ, aḍḍhateyya-ratanappamāṇa-ppadesā uddhaṃ na vijahitabbanti vuttaṃ hoti. aḍḍhateyyaratanabbhantare pana vatthuṃ vaṭṭati. taṃ pamāṇaṃ atikkamitvā sace'pi iddhimā bhikkhū ākāse aruṇaṃ uṭṭhāpeti, nissaggiyam'eva hoti.

examples.text: yattakā bhikkhū tassa uposathakammassa pattayuttā anurūpā, sabb'antimena paricchedena cattāro bhikkhū pakatattā, saṅghena anukkhitā, te ca kho hatthapāsaṃ avijahitvā ekasīmayaṃ ṭhitā.
examples.source: VIN PAT PK saṅghuposatha pubbakaraṇādi vidhi

examples.text: yāva dvārakosā'ti piṭṭhasaṅghāṭassa samantā hatthapāsā.
atirittaṃ nāma kappiyakataṃ hoti, paṭiggahitakataṃ hoti, uccāritakataṃ hoti, hatthapāse kataṃ hoti, bhuttāvinā kataṃ hoti, bhuttāvinā pavāritena āsanā avuṭṭhitena kataṃ hoti

70857.meaning1: top of the hand; back of the hand

examples.text: te evarūpaṃ maṇḍana-vibhūsanaṭṭhān'ānuyogaṃ anuyuttā viharanti, seyyath'idaṃ… hatthabandhaṃ sikhābandhaṃ daṇḍaṃ nāḷikaṃ asiṃ chattaṃ citr'upāhanaṃ uṇhīsaṃ maṇiṃ vālabījaniṃ odātāni vatthāni dīghadasāni

70859.meaning1: just cuts the hand; only slices the hand

examples.text: kuso yathā duggahito, hattham'ev'ānukantati, sāmaññaṃ dupparāmaṭṭhaṃ, nirayāy'ūpakaḍḍhati.
sac'assa hoti avisayhaṃ, hatthavikārena dutiyaṃ āmantetvā hatthavilaṅghakena upaṭṭhāpema, na tv'eva mayaṃ, bhante, tappaccayā vācaṃ bhindāma

70863.meaning2: joining the hands to lift something
70863.commentary: (VINa) hatthavilaṅghakenā'ti hatth'ukkhepakena. (MNa) tato dve janā hatthena hatthaṃ saṃsibbantā dvīsu hatthesu ṭhapetvā upaṭṭhapenti. taṃ sandhāy'āha, hatthavikārena dutiyaṃ āmantetvā hatthavilaṅghakena upaṭṭhapemā'ti.

examples.text: sac'assa hoti avisayhaṃ, hatthavikārena dutiyaṃ āmantetvā hatthavilaṅghakena upaṭṭhāpema, na tv'eva mayaṃ, bhante, tappaccayā vācaṃ bhindāma

70864.meaning1: able to be eaten by hand

examples.text: sūpo nāma dve sūpā, muggasūpo, māsasūpo. hatthahāriyo samasūpako piṇḍapāto paṭiggahetabbo. yo anādariyaṃ paṭicca sūpaññ'eva bahuṃ paṭiggaṇhāti, āpatti dukkaṭassa.
tattha hatth'ārohā'ti sabbe'pi hatth'ācariya-hatthivejja-hatthimeṇḍ'ādayo dasseti. ass'ārohā'ti sabbe'pi ass'ācariya-assavejja-assameṇḍ'ādayo.
atha kho taṃ, bhikkhave, hatthiratanaṃ seyyathā'pi nāma bhaddo hatth'ājānīyo dīgharattaṃ suparidanto evam'eva damathaṃ upeti.

70867.commentary: (VINa) tayo hatthī pacchimaṃ hatth'ānīkan'ti yo pubbe vutto dvādasapuriso hatthī'ti tena hatthinā tayo hatthī.

examples.text: anīkaṃ nāma hatth'ānīkaṃ, ass'ānīkaṃ, rath'ānīkaṃ, patt'ānīkaṃ. tayo hatthī pacchimaṃ hatth'ānīkaṃ, tayo assā pacchimaṃ ass'ānīkaṃ, tayo rathā pacchimaṃ rath'ānīkaṃ, cattāro purisā sarahatthā pattī pacchimaṃ patt'ānīkaṃ.

70868.meaning2: licking the hands after taking meals
70868.commentary: (ANa) hatth'āpalekhano'ti hatthe piṇḍamhi niṭṭhite jivhāya hatthaṃ apalekhati, uccāram'pi katvā hatthasmiṃ'y'eva daṇḍakasaññī hutvā hatthena apalekhati.

examples.text: acelako ce'pi, kassapa, hoti, mutt'ācāro, hatth'āpalekhano… iti evarūpaṃ addhamāsikam'pi pariyāyabhattabhojan'ānuyogam'anuyutto viharati.
idha, bhikkhave, ekacco acelako hoti mutt'ācāro hatth'āpalekhano na-ehibhaddantiko natiṭṭhabhaddantiko n'ābhihaṭaṃ na uddissakataṃ na nimantanaṃ sādiyati.

70870.meaning1: (comm) spell for making the hands turn around
70870.meaning2: incantation for the hands; (comm) spell for making the hands turn around
70870.commentary: (DNa) hatth'ābhijappanan'ti hatthānaṃ parivattan'atthaṃ mantajappanaṃ. tasmiṃ kira mante sattapad'antare ṭhatvā jappite itaro hatthe parivattetvā khipati.

examples.text: seyyath'idaṃ, āvāhanaṃ vivāhanaṃ saṃvaraṇaṃ vivaraṇaṃ saṃkiraṇaṃ vikiraṇaṃ subhagakaraṇaṃ dubbhagakaraṇaṃ viruddhagabbhakaraṇaṃ jivhānibandhanaṃ hanusaṃhananaṃ hatth'ābhijappanaṃ hanujappanaṃ kaṇṇajappanaṃ ādāsapañhaṃ

idha, bhikkhave, rañño nāgo saṅgāmagato hatthim'pi hanati, hatth'āruham'pi hanati, assam'pi hanati, ass'āruham'pi hanati, ratham'pi hanati, rathikam'pi hanati, pattikam'pi hanati. evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, rañño nāgo hantā hoti.

idha, bhikkhave, rañño nāgo saṅgāmagato rakkhati purimaṃ kāyaṃ, rakkhati pacchimaṃ kāyaṃ, rakkhati purime pāde, rakkhati pacchime pāde, rakkhati sīsaṃ, rakkhati kaṇṇe, rakkhati dante, rakkhati soṇḍaṃ, rakkhati vāladhiṃ, rakkhati hatth'āruhaṃ. evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, rañño nāgo rakkhitā hoti.
yathā te khameyya, tathā naṃ byākareyyāsi. taṃ kiṃ maññasi, rājakumāra, kusalo tvaṃ hatth'ārūḷhe aṅkusagayhe sippe'ti? evaṃ, bhante, kusalo ahaṃ hatth'ārūḷhe aṅkusagayhe sippe'ti.
hatth'ārohassa evaṃ hoti, ayaṃ kho rañño nāgo īsādanto urūḷhavā abhijāto saṅgām'āvacaro saṅgāmagato… rakkhat'eva soṇḍaṃ.
atha kho pesso ca hatth'ārohaputto kandarako ca paribbājako yena bhagavā ten'upasaṅkamiṃsu, upasaṅkamitvā pesso hatth'ārohaputto bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekam'antaṃ nisīdi.
hatth'ārohassa evaṃ hoti, ayaṃ kho rañño nāgo īsādanto urūḷhavā abhijāto saṅgām'āvacaro saṅgāmagato… rakkhat'eva soṇḍaṃ.
atha kho pesso ca hatth'ārohaputto kandarako ca paribbājako yena bhagavā ten'upasaṅkamiṃsu, upasaṅkamitvā pesso hatth'ārohaputto bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekam'antaṃ nisīdi.

70879.commentary: (ANa) hatth'āpalekhano'ti hatthe piṇḍamhi niṭṭhite jivhāya hatthaṃ apalekhati, uccāram'pi katvā hatthasmiṃ'y'eva daṇḍakasaññī hutvā hatthena apalekhati.

examples.text: acelako ce'pi, kassapa, hoti, mutt'ācāro, hatth'āvalekhano… iti evarūpaṃ addhamāsikam'pi pariyāyabhattabhojan'ānuyogam'anuyutto viharati.

70880.commentary: (SNa) hatthayo pasadā migā'ti hatthino ca pasadamigā ca.

examples.text: haṃsā koñcā mayūrā ca, hatthayo pasadā migā, sabbe sīhassa bhāyanti, n'atthi kāyasmiṃ tulyatā.
asi ca cammañ'ca asicammaṃ, dhanu ca kalāpo ca dhanukalāpaṃ, hatthī ca asso ca hatthi-assaṃ, ratho ca pattiko ca rathapattikaṃ. evaṃ sen'aṅg'atthe.
kiñ'c'āpi te hatthikāyo vā rakkheyya, assakāyo vā rakkheyya, rathakāyo vā rakkheyya, pattikāyo vā rakkheyya, atha kho tesaṃ arakkhito attā.

atha kho bhagavā bhaṇḍagāme yath'ābhirantaṃ viharitvā āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ āmantesi, āyām'ānanda, yena hatthigāmo, yena ambagāmo, yena jambugāmo, yena bhoganagaraṃ ten'upasaṅkamissāmā'ti. evaṃ, bhante'ti kho āyasmā ānando bhagavato paccassosi.

70898.meaning1: from the village of Hatthi; who lives in the hamlet of Hatthi

examples.text: atha kho uggo gahapati hatthigāmako yena bhagavā ten'upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā ekam'antaṃ nisīdi.

70899.commentary: (THa) yātaṃ me hatthigīvāyā'ti, bhante, pubbe mayā gacchantenā'pi hatthigīvāya hatthikkhandhe nisīditvā yātaṃ caritaṃ.

examples.text: yātaṃ me hatthigīvāya, sukhumā vatthā padhāritā, sālīnaṃ odano bhutto, sucimaṃs'ūpasecano.

taṃ kiṃ maññasi, ambaṭṭha, idha rājā pasenadi kosalo hatthigīvāya vā nisinno assapiṭṭhe vā nisinno rath'ūpatthare vā ṭhito uggehi vā rājaññehi vā kiñci'd'eva mantanaṃ manteyya. so tamhā padesā apakkamma ekam'antaṃ tiṭṭheyya.
